title: Depth bounded by available coordinates
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite alphabet and let $T$ be a decision tree whose available coordinates form a finite set $A$. The maximum number of queries along any path in $T$ is at most $|A|$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of available coordinates
